verses.html: A Song of degrees. They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
verses.text: A Song of degrees. They that trust in the LORD shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
verses.title: A Song of degrees.

verses.html: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.text: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the LORD is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

verses.html: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.text: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

verses.html: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.text: Do good, O LORD, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

verses.html: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
verses.text: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, the LORD shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Israel.
